clips.title: The story
paras: On the Echo Isles, Minshina's Skull holds the bound soul of Minshina, a Darkspear troll and brother of Master Gadrin. Zalazane trapped him there after driving the tribe from the isles, and uses the skull to fuel dark rituals.

Minshina was captured and slain when Zalazane seized the Echo Isles and drove out the Darkspear. The traitorous witch doctor bound his victim's soul to Minshina's severed skull instead of letting him pass into death. The skull lies within a circle of power on the southernmost isle, tethering Minshina to Zalazane's magic. Tormented by dreams of his brother calling to him, Master Gadrin seeks brave travelers to enter the occupied islands, reclaim the skull, and break Zalazane's hold over Minshina's spirit.
